description: Simulated price-adders for the remuneration of reserves in scarcity situations (Archive dataset) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Scarcity price-adders simulated by Elia in the context of the 2019 discretionary incentive on scarcity pricing laid upon Elia by CREG. This simulation is based on a scarcity pricing model as conceptualized in the note by CREG and UCL CORE on the general design of a mechanism for the remuneration of reserves in scarcity situations. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Studies. Its keywords are Market. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
